note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1914: contests in Ballymartrim, Brootally, Clady, Glenaul and Middletown. Labels are printed only in the results of the contests. Returned unopposed. Printed "Tullyrone". Isaac Allen: no party label printed in 1914. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Annaghmore, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1914, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests"); nominations in the Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council")). William Elliott: no party label printed in 1914. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Tullyroan, 27 May 1908, printed 'U.': Irish News and Belfast Morning News, 30 May 1908, p. 8 ("Armagh Rural Council"); nominations from the Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1908, p. 3 ("For Armagh Rural Council": nominations; "a" = against direct labour, "d l" = direct labour); Tullyroan, 29 May 1924, printed 'U': Northern Whig, 1 May 1924, p. 10 ("Armagh Rural District"); Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1924, p. 2 ("Armagh Rural Council": nominations with party labels)).
